meta.name: himalayan_monastery
meta.prompt: A Himalayan monastery clinging to a cliff face above a glacier, prayer flags strung across the gorge, a village of yak herders on the moraine below.

character.label: Himalayan cliffside monastery and moraine settlement

programs.brief: Long braided suspension lines strung with dense rows of vibrant prayer flags spanning across the rocky gorge between stone anchor cairns on opposing cliff faces.
A fractured tongue of turquoise packed ice, blue ice seracs, and embedded dark moraine boulders wedged in the floor of the glacial gorge.
A sacred drystone mani wall piled high with inscribed slate prayer tablets, carved mantras, yak skulls, and miniature flag poles.

tokens.terrain: a sheer cliff face towering above a glacier and gravel moraine valley, with a deep gorge cutting between rock faces
tokens.icons: lines of colourful prayer flags spanning the gorge; chortens and mani stone cairns marking the cliff tracks; yak herder stone huts and dung drying yards on the moraine below
tokens.infra: prayer_flag_line across the gorge; cliff_stair connecting the high assembly hall down to the valley trail; dry_stone_wall enclosing the yak paddocks on the moraine

root.label: The High Himalayan Pass, Cliff Monastery, and Moraine
